name: @prometheus-ags/a2ui-uar
description: UAR-owned React renderer for the A2UI protocol (uar.a2ui/1), built directly on @prometheus-ags/a2ui-core (@a2ui/web_core). Uses shadcn/ui as the visual baseline and react-aria-components for accessibility primitives that shadcn/Base UI does not cover (multi-select ChoicePicker). This is the renderer UAR product code should import — @prometheus-ags/a2ui-react is a reference implementation only.
